implementation: Native cross-origin Window property descriptor machinery and GC-traced memoization; configured native host callbacks are not yet the production Window operation implementations, and production frame contexts do not use the policy yet.

coverage: Native named/indexed access and ordered own keys
Caller-realm native descriptor getter identity and descriptor attributes
Non-callable method snapshots; callable replacements use native operations; author getters not invoked
Memoized values and callable identity stable across forced GC and author mutation
Retained method preserves original Window context after navigation
Retired original context collected after retained methods/getters are released
Definitions and deletions use native SecurityError via public V8 failed-access callback
Native DOMException branding survives author global constructor replacement

cache_ownership.storage: Oryn user context embedder data slot 0, offset by rusty_v8 internal slots; no other current Oryn user embedder slots
cache_ownership.memoization: V8 WeakMap keyed by target original-context key object, with values retained ephemerally; target key and caller map belong to their respective context GC graphs
cache_ownership.intrinsics: One private pristine V8 context per isolate supplies trusted native WeakMap constructor/get/set; no author JS or cache polyfill executes

historical_denial_logs_note: Denial-only diagnostics predate corrected method-value/cache semantics. Latest context-tests.log is authoritative for current tests.
